Callout.Name: Abnormal Load Escort
Callout.Message: Escort requested for an abnormal load.
Callout.Advisory: Load waiting, route surveyed, timings agreed.

Script.Line: It is over the limit on width and it needs an escort to the county line.
Five miles an hour, and there is no way round it on that road.
One unit in front and one behind. That is what we agreed.

Lines.Approach: They cannot move until somebody is in front of it. It is a slow one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
